title: Senior Tax Analyst, Corporate Tax
description:
Where Conviviality is at work.

Pernod Ricard is a global premium international champagnes and spirits company. We’re the team behind leading brands such as ABSOLUT® Vodka, Jameson® Irish Whiskey, Malibu®, Kahlúa® Liqueur, The Glenlivet®, Beefeater and Malfy Gins, and a leading portfolio of American whiskey brands including Jefferson’s, Rabbit Hole, TX, Smooth Ambler and Skrewball™ whiskey.

Working at Pernod Ricard is all about igniting conviviality in all that we do. Derived from the French word, convivialité…it means human connection, authenticity, friendly, and jovial. Conviviality is energy and spirit with a splash of je ne sais quoi and is a core philosophy around how we live and work at Pernod Ricard.

  

Guided by our 4 core values: (1) grounded in the real; (2) fiercely authentic; (3) passion for challenge; and (4) connected beyond borders; we are team players, dream makers, trailblazers, movers and (cocktail) shakers. We have a passion for living life to the fullest, making new friends every day, and realizing our potential as people and as a business!

The salary range for this role, based in New York, is $91,300.00 to $125,598.00. The range may vary if the role outside of this location. Base salaries are determined during our interview process, by assessing a candidate’s experience, skills against internal peers and against the scope and responsibilities of the position.

**Job Summary:**

Join Pernod Ricard's U.S. Tax team and play a critical role in supporting tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities across a dynamic portfolio of domestic and international entities. Reporting to the Tax Director, this role offers broad exposure to corporate income tax, tax accounting, audits, transfer pricing, and strategic tax initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, partnering across functions, and contributing to a high-performing finance organization.

**Who will love this job:**

You will thrive in this role if you:

* Enjoy navigating complex tax regulations and translating technical concepts into business insights.
* Have a strong attention to detail and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.
* Are naturally curious and stay informed on evolving tax laws and regulatory developments.
* Enjoy partnering with stakeholders across finance, accounting, FP&A, and international teams.
* Take ownership of your work and can successfully manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Are motivated by continuous learning, process improvement, and finding more efficient ways to work.

**What you’ll do**:

  

* Prepare federal income tax and non-income tax filings.
* Review state and local income tax returns to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Support quarterly and year-end tax provision processes, including forecast reporting and IFRIC 23 requirements.
* Prepare monthly tax account reconciliations and analyze tax-related balances.
* Respond to notices and inquiries from federal, state, and local taxing authorities.
* Assist with federal and state tax audits and support requests from auditors.
* Manage and monitor tax filing calendars to ensure timely compliance with all filing obligations.
* Conduct tax research and contribute to tax planning initiatives and transfer pricing analyses.
* Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, affiliates, and global tax teams on tax-related matters.
* Monitor technical tax developments and assess potential impacts on the business.
* Participate in special projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance tax processes and controls.

**What’s in it for me?**

Being part of an inclusive and diverse company where professional development and internal career mobility is front-and-center to our talent strategy. This means your career at Pernod Ricard has many possibilities. You'll be part of a culture that celebrates the rich diversity of our people across the globe and be part of our long-standing commitment to making exceptional products, giving back to our communities, and honoring our responsibility to preserve the environment.

**Required qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.
* CPA designation required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience within a Big 4 or well-regarded public accounting firm focused on corporate tax compliance and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate income tax law, state and local taxation, and international tax concepts.
* Experience preparing and reviewing corporate income tax returns and related tax accounting under ASC 740 and/or IAS 12.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ONESOURCE, and Bloomberg Tax.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex information and deliver actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for learning and process enhancement.

title: FP&A Analyst - Car Rental Business
description:
**Driven to be the Best**

**People. Performance. Purpose.**

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. Our 25,000 employees raise the bar every day, bringing different perspectives, taking ownership, and leading with integrity. We’re defining the future of mobility with safe, sustainable solutions that move people, businesses, and communities forward.

We're looking for an **FP&A Analyst** to join the team supporting financial reporting and performance analysis across our rental business segments. This role sits at the intersection of Sales and Finance — translating commercial performance into financial results and helping the business understand why the numbers move the way they do. The core focus of this role is supporting the ongoing development of our profit allocation tool.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reporting on business segment performance (e.g., corporate accounts, channels, geographies, rate/mix)
* Analyze P&L results against sales plans, forecast, and prior year; identify and explain key drivers of variance
* Support the Sales–Finance link by translating account/segment performance trends into financial terms sales leaders can act on, and vice versa
* Assist in building out and maintaining the revenue and cost allocation tool — including logic for attributing P&L cost lines down to the rental agreement level, and applying driver-based allocation methods for costs that can't be directly attributed
* Partner with IT, Risk, and other Finance teams to gather requirements, test logic, and validate outputs as the allocation tool evolves
* Pull and manipulate data from internal systems (Oracle/OCI, Redshift, etc.) using SQL; build and maintain models/reporting in Excel
* Support month-end closing and reporting cycles with accurate, timely deliverables
* Step in to support the wider Commercial Finance team on ad hoc projects and priority requests
* Continuously looking for ways to improve reporting efficiency and data quality

**Perks You’ll Get:**

  

* Access to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance
* Eligible to elect other voluntary benefits including: Group Auto Insurance, Group Home Insurance, Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, Identity Theft Protection, FSA, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and additional life insurance coverages
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matched contributions
* Full training to learn the business and enhance professional skills
* Employee discounts, including discounted prices on the purchase of Avis/Budget cars
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program for services including counseling, financial and legal consultation, referrals for care service and more

**What We're Looking For:**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable digging into data to find the "why"
* Working knowledge of P&L structure and financial analysis fundamentals
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to work cross-functionally
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; comfort with the broader Microsoft Office suite
* SQL/Python proficiency a strong plus
* Familiarity with applying AI/automation tools to reporting and analysis workflows is a plus
* A genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for the business, not just the numbers
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

The annual starting salary for this position is between $65,000 – $80,000 annually. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

**Who We Are:**

Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.

Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.

We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

This advertisement does not constitute a promise or guarantee of employment. This advertisement describes the general nature and level of this position only. Essential functions and responsibilities may change as business needs require. The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. This position may be with any affiliate of Avis Budget Group.

description:

* Maintain enterprise financial models that consolidate business projections across the P&L and cash flow, incorporating key business drivers.
* Develop scenario planning and what-if analyses to assess the potential impact of market conditions, business decisions, and organizational changes.

title: Associate, Strategic Finance
description:
**About the Company**

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a passionate, driven individual to join our team as an Associate, Strategic Finance. The Strategic Finance team is responsible for informing company strategy, implementing new business initiatives, coordinating capital markets activity, and performing advanced financial modeling. You will have a unique opportunity to work cross-functionally and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across the whole organization, including standing up processes from zero to one. The best candidates will be quantitatively excellent, intellectually curious, AI-native, and able to operate with a high degree of autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

### **Responsibilities**

* Work cross-functionally with our business leaders on all aspects of strategic finance, including but not limited to business plan formation, long-range planning and strategic alternatives
* Drive monthly reporting cadence — close actuals, budget-vs-actual, and the rolling reforecast — and connect reported performance to the revenue, headcount, and spend drivers behind it
* Build and maintain financial models, unit economics, and business cases to support key strategic decisions across the organization
* Support the broader Strategic Finance mandate, including long-range planning, board and management presentations, and ad hoc analytical questions that inform company strategy
* Contribute to materials and process for future equity and debt financings as needed
* Leverage AI tools to build out and improve existing models, dashboards, and reporting architecture

### **Ideal Background**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* 1–2+ years of experience in investment banking, consulting, private equity, strategic finance, or an operating role at a high-growth startup
* Excellent financial modeling and presentation skills — comfortable building a model from a blank sheet
* Proven ability to take initiative, operate independently, and act like an owner
* Fluency with AI tools and a genuine interest in applying them to finance and strategy work
* Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly shifting priorities — energized by zero-to-one problems
* Intellectually curious and quick to get up to speed on unfamiliar industries, business models, and technical domains
* Strong written and verbal communication; can distill complex analysis into a crisp narrative
* Willingness to work under pressure to produce outstanding results
* Track record of integrity, sound judgment, and genuine collaboration

We take care of our people so they can do their best work.

* ***Financial***401(k) retirement plan, healthcare and dependent care FSAs, HSA-compatible plan options with annual employer HSA funding and pre-tax commuter benefits.
* ***Life at Flow***Weekly catered lunches, wellness classes and employee discounts on Flow hotel stays, grocer products, and merch.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
**About Us**
------------

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  
  
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  
  
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.  
  
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  
  
Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**The Role**
------------

Legora is scaling quickly, and our accounting team is growing with it. We’re hiring a Corporate Accounting Manager in New York to run our global close and manage a team of senior accountants across New York and Stockholm.

You’ll own the close end to end and make it faster and more reliable as we prepare for SOX and move to NetSuite. You’ll report to the Assistant Controller and work closely with Technical Accounting, FP&A, Tax, and our AP, AR, and Payroll teams.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Run the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close across all entities, including the close calendar, journal entry review, reconciliations, and flux analysis
* Shorten our close by standardizing the close checklist, templates, and review process across entities, and automate manual work, including with AI tools
* Own what the Corporate accounting team in New York and Stockholm delivers each month, from task assignment to final sign-off
* Prepare key reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries alongside the team during close when needed
* Partner with the AP, AR, and Payroll leads on cutoff, accruals, and the other inputs the close depends on
* Partner with Technical Accounting to book and support complex areas such as leases and capitalized software
* Help integrate acquired entities into our close, consolidation, and control environment
* Own our balance sheet reconciliation standards and design internal controls as we prepare for SOX
* Serve as the main point of contact for our external auditors and own the audit timeline
* Lead the accounting side of our move to NetSuite
* Partner with FP&A on monthly reporting and with Tax on key inputs for provisions, transfer pricing, and indirect tax

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 6+ years of accounting experience, including time at a high-growth tech company
* Experience running a multi-entity close and consolidation under US GAAP
* A track record of shortening a close or rebuilding close processes at a growing company
* Strong US GAAP knowledge
* Experience managing accountants as direct reports
* Audit experience: you’ve been the main point of contact and kept the audit on schedule
* Detail-oriented: you keep the close on schedule and still check the work yourself
* Clear communicator, comfortable working across time zones with Finance and the rest of the business

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* CPA or other accounting certification
* Big 4 audit experience
* IFRS or K3 experience
* Experience implementing SOX controls at a pre-IPO or public company
* NetSuite experience, ideally including an ERP migration
* Experience using AI tools in accounting workflows

**What’s In It For You**

description:
**Open role in MTP Office locations, including New York, and Chicago**

**Visa Sponsorship** is not available for this position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without requiring employer sponsorship.

  

**Role Overview**

The Corporate Controller owns accounting, consolidation, and financial reporting for Meet The People's 13 legal entities across the United States and Canada. This role produces one accurate, timely set of consolidated financials from a multi-entity, multi-currency group, and owns the close, internal controls, and the external audit. As the group's corporate accounting lead, the Controller sets the accounting policies, close standards, and controls that every pillar and entity finance team follows.

The Controller will also serve as interim head of finance for one of MTP's agencies, spending roughly 30–40% of their time running that agency's finance function and developing its Director of Finance to take on the full role.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** (Other duties may be assigned)

**Consolidation and Multi-entity Accounting**

* Consolidate all 13 US and Canadian entities into accurate, timely consolidated financial statements under US GAAP.
* Run intercompany accounting, including transactions, cross-charges, reconciliations, and elimination entries across all entities.
* Maintain a consistent chart of accounts, accounting policies, and close procedures across every entity.
* Set group-wide close calendars, reporting packages, and review standards for pillar and entity finance teams, and review their submissions before consolidation.
* Build scalable consolidation processes and tools that can absorb new entities as MTP grows.

**Close and Financial Reporting**

* Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for all entities on a defined, predictable calendar.
* Prepare consolidated and entity-level financial statements, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
* Oversee transactional accounting across entities; own balance sheet integrity, including intercompany transaction reconciliations.
* Partner with operations, HR, and IT so transactional data flows cleanly and accurately into the accounting records.
* Provide the CFO and leadership with accurate actuals, account analysis, and variance explanations for management reporting.

**Internal Controls and Accounting Policy**

* Establish, document, and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Own the internal control environment and risk assessment over financial reporting.
* Oversee technical accounting, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and business combinations (ASC 805).

**Audit and Tax**

* Coordinate the annual external audit and act as the auditors' primary day-to-day contact; resolve audit findings and implement corrective actions promptly.
* Coordinate US and Canadian tax compliance with external tax advisors, including income tax, sales tax, GST/HST, and 1099 information reporting.
* Support the CFO on tax planning and in relationships with tax advisors, banks, and other financial partners.

**Acquisitions and Integration**

* Support financial due diligence for acquisitions if needed, focusing on the quality of the target's accounting, controls, and close.
* Run accounting integration of acquired companies, including purchase accounting and opening balance sheets.
* Account for earnouts and contingent consideration, including periodic remeasurement.
* Bring new entities into the consolidation, close calendar, and control environment quickly.

**Interim Agency Head of Finance**

* Serve as interim head of finance for one of MTP's pillars, overseeing the pillar's accounting, close, and financial reporting until the existing director of finance is ready for the role.
* Deliver accurate, on-time monthly financial statements and reporting packages for the agency leadership.

The Corporate Finance Department at Warner Music Group is responsible for overseeing all of the financial operations of the Company in partnership with the finance groups at the labels and individual companies within Warner Music Group. The department provides financial reporting, accounting, planning, budgeting, and financial compliance for the Company. The department is filled with fun, outgoing and overall successful individuals who work hard all while enjoying the perks of working in the Music Industry.

**Your role:**

Warner Music Group is excited to offer this opportunity in the Corporate Finance Department. This position is responsible for analyzing certain income statement accounts and other key reporting metrics for budget, actuals and forecast submissions on a consolidated basis for Warner Music Group. This position reports to the VP of Financial Reporting.

**Here you’ll get to:**

* Prepare financial statement analytics and reviews for non-operating income statement activity (i.e. “below-the-line” accounts) for budget, actuals and forecasts
* Coordinate with segments and affiliates on the accurate recording and submission of below-the-line activity for all required income statement submissions including depreciation, amortization, interest expense, interest income, equity income, noncontrolling interest, foreign exchange gains and losses, and other non-operating activity.
* Prepare of debt covenant calculations, including a trailing twelve months adjusted EBITDA calculation, for budget, forecasts, and quarterly and annual report periods
* Prepare CFO Analytics Package which is used by the Company’s Global CFO to assist in their preparation of the quarterly earnings process
* Assist in preparation of management reporting deliverables for key metrics and below-the-line analysis
* Collaborate with external reporting and technical accounting to ensure below-the-line activity is properly reported in accordance with US GAAP and disclosed in the WMG quarterly and annual financial statements (e.g. Form 10-K, Form 10-Q)
* Assist with the preparation review of certain monthly recurring journal entries in our consolidation system (HFM)
* Oversee the Sr. Financial Analyst – Consolidations and Financial Reporting who is responsible for performing the monthly intercompany reconciliation, monitoring the status of the monthly close, and preparing various financial reporting deliverables.
* Liaise directly with Financial Planning and Analysis to prepare quarterly income statement analysis, management discussion and analysis, and other ad-hoc reporting and analysis in connection with our quarterly earnings process.
* Collaborate with External Reporting and Investor Relations to assist in the development in the quarterly and annual press releases earning scripts documents, and other financial communications.

**About you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance
* Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in accounting
* Big Four public accounting or large multinational experience preferred
* CPA or CPA candidate a plus
* Intermediate level knowledge of GAAP/SEC accounting and reporting

* Strong work-ethic and a self-starter with effective organizational skills with attention to detail who proactively seeks out new solutions
* Demonstrate problem solving, decision making, and continuous process improvement skills

Controllers ensure that the firm meets all the financial control and reporting obligations of a global, regulated, and public financial institution. Our professionals measure the profitability of, and risks associated with, every aspect of the firm's business. Controllers also ensure that the firm's activities are conducted in compliance with the regulations governing transactions in the financial markets.

Capital, Analysis, Planning and Reporting is responsible managing the firm’s capital calculations, planning and attribution (attributed equity). Our team oversees the calculation, forecasting, and reporting of various regulatory and internal capital metrics including the Standardized and Advanced Capital Ratios, Supplementary Leverage Ratio (SLR), Global Systemically Important Bank (G-SIB) surcharge, and Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) capital ratios.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Calculate, analyze and report regulatory capital, leverage, and systemic risk
* Enhance and improve workflow and infrastructure to meet current and future regulatory rules and reporting requirements
* Serve as the primary regulatory capital liaison to the business units by providing subject matter expertise
* Provide business level capital attribution to assist revenue divisions committing capital to facilitate client requests
* Respond to various ad-hoc requests with detailed analysis
* Assist in developing short and long term capital projections
* Perform analytics on data while being able to summarize and communicate related findings
* Develop and manage relationships with colleagues from the broader controllers teams, as well as Corporate Treasury; Risk; Legal; and Technology

**Desired Experience / Skills:**

* Undergraduate degree in accounting, economics or finance preferred, but not required
* CPA, or CFA preferred, but not required
* 1-3 years relevant experience
* Regulatory (i.e. Basel III Standardized, Advanced, Supplemental Leverage, GSIB) experience preferred, but not required
* Ability to work within a team and to collaborate with peers and leadership to drive firmwide initiatives

title: Senior Analyst, Pricing
description:
The Senior Pricing Analyst will independently execute and support the firm’s pricing strategy by partnering with lawyers, the Client Development and Engagement team, and other Finance teams to design, implement and track client fee agreements. This role combines financial analysis, matter budgeting, and direct partner support, and will own and help maintain pricing processes, tools, and databases. The Senior Analyst will support the capture and upkeep of pricing data and insights so they can be leveraged effectively across the firm.

This is a collaborative, hands-on role for a commercially minded professional who can balance analytical rigor with strong communication, process management, and strong follow-through.

  

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

  

Pricing & Partner Support

  

* Collaborate with partners to develop and evaluate fee proposals, budgets, and alternative fee arrangements (AFAs).
* Independently provide financial modeling and analysis to support client negotiations and business development opportunities.
* Draft first-pass fee estimates from selected precedents within familiar practice areas.
* Assist partners in preparing and securing approvals from the firm’s Finance Committee by supplying data-driven insights and business cases.
Present findings to the team and explain the analysis behind them; educate and advise partners on pricing trends, client expectations, and firm guidelines.  

  

Financial Analysis & Tracking

  

* Build and monitor matter budgets, analyze budget to actual variances and drivers of performance, providing updates and insights to partners and leadership.
* Track fee agreements and matter performance against expectations, highlighting trends and risks.
* Prepare reports and dashboards that present pricing outcomes, client behaviors, and profitability metrics.
Use AI-assisted analytics to accelerate data pulls, draft estimates, and flag anomalies in routine work.  

  

Process Support

  

* Support pricing processes and partner requests by producing accurate, timely analyses and work product.
* Coordinate with the Rates & Compliance, Finance, and Client Development and Engagement teams to ensure consistent inputs and high-quality output for partners and practice groups.
Help document and follow efficient workflows, ensuring consistency and scalability of pricing support across the firm.  

  

Pricing Tools & Database Support

  

* Own recurring data pulls and datasets end to end, and maintain and validate the accuracy of the firm’s pricing databases, tools, and templates.
* Ensure pricing data is captured consistently, enabling robust analysis and reporting.
* Partner with IT and other Finance teams to enhance tools and processes that improve efficiency and client service.
* Build, test, and maintain AI-enabled pricing workflows, such as automated data pulls, first-draft fee estimates, budget-to-actual variance checks, and anomaly flagging, that other team members can adopt.
* Use Claude and Harvey to analyze and summarize matter data, research precedent matters and engagement terms, draft pricing narratives and proposal content, and prototype analyses and tools, applying prompt design and iteration to produce reliable, repeatable results.
Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and fit against source data and pricing expertise, document quality checks and limitations, and ensure compliance with client confidentiality and firm AI policies; pilot new AI use cases and train partners and colleagues on approved tools and workflows.  

  

Best Practices & Process Improvement

  

* Improve templates and process steps, record the changes, and support the creation and roll-out of pricing playbooks, guidelines, and templates.
* Drive adoption of consistent approaches to scoping, budgeting, and fee negotiations.
Contribute to firm-wide initiatives that improve value delivery, efficiency, and financial outcomes.  

  

Client Engagement Support

  

* Play an active role in RFPs, client negotiations, and fee discussions.
Provide strategic support in creating and presenting value-driven, competitive proposals.  

  
  

**Education**

  

Required

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field.  

  

**Skills & Experience**

* 4-6 years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, or related roles within professional services (law firm experience preferred).
* Proficiency in MS Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of financial metrics such as realization, leverage, effective rate, and margin.
* Hands-on experience building with generative AI tools, such as Claude and Harvey, including prompt design, workflow automation, and light scripting or low-code tools.
* Sound judgment on responsible AI use in a law firm setting, including confidentiality, data privacy, and verification of AI-generated work.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple requests with competing deadlines.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical skills with the ability to utilize tools to compile and analyze data and recommend and/or implement solutions to complex problems.
* Significant working understanding of alternative fee arrangements and pricing of legal/professional services.
* Demonstrated ability to apply principles of logical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Self-directed and proactive capable of thriving in a dynamic environment.
* Experience working with all levels of personnel within law firms and clients.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Demonstrates strong problem-solving abilities and effective negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to adapt to change and balance competing demands and priorities.
* Organized, proactive, and commercially minded with strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency in working with structured data and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.

title: Partnerships Lead, New Verticals
description:
**About Figure**

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure's on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure's ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.  
  
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody's on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.  
  
We're proud to be recognized as one of Forbes' Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies.

**About the Role**

You will scale three New Verticals: depository institutions, home improvement, and small business lending.

This role grows the volume of loans originated on Figure's platform. We want lenders, platforms, and depository institutions to originate on Figure's loan origination system, through private-label programs, embedded and SaaS-style integrations, and direct adoption. You take these partnerships from first conversation through launch and scaling: structuring the commercial terms, negotiating, and pulling together the internal teams needed to launch.

You will report to the Director of Platform Partnerships and primarily own the hard middle of the process, where partnerships are actually won or lost.

Work across Figure's key growth markets (including small business, home improvement, and depository institutions) to bring partners onto the platform via direct relationships, private-label programs, embedded integrations, and key channel ecosystem partnerships.

**What You'll Do**

* Map the market and source high-value strategic, product, and channel partnerships.
* Structure and negotiate the commercial terms and product setup for each partner.
* Build our new bank and credit union channel, landing the partners and integrations that make Figure easy for these institutions to adopt.
* Win partnerships in the home improvement and small business lending ecosystems that drive funded volume across multiple products (e.g. HELOC, fix-&-flip, DSCR).
* Coordinate the internal teams a launch depends on, including product, engineering, credit, legal, and implementation, to get partners live and scaling.
* Own each partnership internally. Spot where it is likely to stall and clear the path before it does.
* Build repeatable program structures and playbooks so each new partnership moves faster than the last.
* Track your deal pipeline and activity in Salesforce (our CRM).

**What We Look For**

* 5+ years in strategic partnerships, investment banking, venture capital / private equity, business development, consulting, or a related field (we care way more about your actual impact and scope of work than the exact years on your resume—so if you're a bit outside this range, definitely still apply!). Experience with lending, fintech, SaaS, or financial institutions is a plus.
* A track record building platform, product, or channel partnerships, ideally involving banks, credit unions, and non-bank lenders – including the systems they run on.
* Strong negotiation skills and the patience to run a long, multi-party process all the way to launch.
* A working understanding of consumer and small-business lending. You do not need deep capital-markets expertise for this role, but you should understand how originations work.
* Organized and detail-oriented, and good at getting cross-functional teams to move.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to own outcomes.
* Nice to have: experience partnering with or selling into depositories, POS, LOS, or core integrations, or home-improvement and small-business lending.
* Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
* Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
* Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

**Salary**

* Base Compensation Range: $120,000 - $150,000/yr
* On-target earnings: $190,000 - $240,000/yr
* Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

title: Head of Private Equity Partnerships
description:
**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

**About the Role**

Tabs is looking for a Head of Private Equity Partnerships to build and lead our PE channel. A strong PE strategy can build both near term trust and firm activation and unlock a portfolio over time. We want someone who can turn that into a repeatable engine.

You’ll own the channel end to end: the strategy, the targets, the partner program, and building out the team. That means deciding which firms we prioritize and how we engage them, building the playbook and infrastructure that turn relationships into pipeline and revenue every quarter, and hiring the people who run it. You’ll balance maintaining hundreds of relationships with operating partners and investors with building out the playbook, reporting, and tooling the channel runs on.

This role is ideal for someone who has built a PE partner program before, knows how value creation teams think, and wants to do it again with real ownership at a fast-growing company.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Set Channel Strategy:** Define where we play in PE, including which firms, fund types, and portfolio profiles to prioritize, and how the channel hits its pipeline and revenue targets every quarter.
* **Activate and Expand Firms:** Source new firm relationships and deepen existing ones across managing directors, operating partners, value creation teams, and portfolio CFOs. Turn each relationship into a steady flow of portfolio introductions.
* **Build the Partner Program:** Own the PE partner program and playbook, including partner tiers and incentives, value creation initiatives, portfolio-wide offers, events, and content that make Tabs easy to recommend.
* **Own the Number:** Carry the channel’s pipeline and revenue targets. Build the forecasting, reporting, and operating cadence that shows what’s working and where to double down.
* **Build and Lead the Team:** Hire, coach, and develop a team of high-performing partner managers, and set the bar for how we show up with firms.
* **Build the Infrastructure:** Stand up the tooling, CRM workflows, and processes the channel needs to scale, and do the IC work yourself when that’s the fastest path.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Work closely with our other partnerships channels, Sales, Marketing and Product to shepherd partner-sourced deals to close, bring portfolio feedback into the roadmap, and keep our positioning sharp for PE audiences.
* **Represent Tabs within the industry:** Be the face of Tabs at industry events, partner offsites, and portfolio CFO forums.

**Who You Are**

* **Hunter and Harvester:** You’re as comfortable engaging and activating new firms as you are running a long-term account plan with an existing one. You know how to drive near-term pipeline and revenue without spending down long-term trust.
* **Strategic:** You see the forest for the trees, set clear and confident direction, and can explain the tradeoffs between different paths forward.
* **Executive Presence:** You’re credible in a room with managing directors and operating partners, and you communicate with confidence, structure, and clarity.
* **First Principled and Data Backed:** You form strong opinions from data and first principles, and you update them when the data changes.
* **Curious and Fast Learning:** You want to deeply understand partner dynamics, our product, and our buyer, and you pick up new concepts quickly.
* **Builder:** You have a strong bias for action and are excited to scale an early channel, including rolling up your sleeves to put the foundation in place.
* **Bold:** You have a vision for what a best-in-class PE partnerships program looks like and the drive to get us there.
* This role is likely a strong fit for candidates with 10+ years of experience, often coming from PE value creation, PE partnerships at a high-growth software company, or commercial leadership selling into PE-backed companies.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in private equity value creation, PE partnerships, or sales at a high-growth company
* Experience building a PE partner program from the ground up, including channel strategy, partner programs, value creation initiatives, events, and team building
* Strong track record leading commercial teams and consistently hitting pipeline and revenue targets
* Experience hiring and managing a team of high performers
* An established network across PE firms, operating partners, and portfolio finance leaders
* Excellent communicator and relationship builder who can balance building trust with driving commercial outcomes

**Additional Information**

This role is based in New York City at our Soho office.

**Perks and Benefits (Full-time Employees)**

* Parental leave up to 12 weeks

* Voluntary insurances (Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, Accident)
* Employee Assistance Program (Rightway)

* 401k

title: Tax and Compliance Manager
description:
CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

The Tax & Compliance Manager is responsible for overseeing CrossCountry's indirect tax and compliance activities across its global operating entities. This role manages multi-jurisdictional tax compliance, supports transfer pricing initiatives, identifies tax planning opportunities, and ensures adherence to applicable domestic and international regulations. The position serves as a key partner to Finance, Operations, Accounting, and external advisors, helping the organization maintain compliance while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical tax expertise, a solid accounting foundation, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Tax Compliance & Reporting**

* Manage indirect tax compliance across city, county, state, federal, and international jurisdictions, including payroll tax, sales and use tax, VAT, GST, property tax, franchise tax, and annual business license filings.
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings and reporting requirements.
* Assist with the preparation and review of corporate income tax returns across multiple jurisdictions, as needed.
* Monitor tax compliance obligations and proactively address emerging requirements.

**Transfer Pricing**

* Oversee transfer pricing arrangements and ensure compliance with applicable domestic and international regulations governing intercompany transactions.
* Partner with external advisors to prepare, maintain, and update transfer pricing documentation in accordance with arm's-length standards.
* Review transfer pricing structures and support compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

**Tax Planning & Strategy**

* Monitor changes in indirect tax legislation, regulations, rulings, and case law, communicating potential business impacts to key stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to optimize the firm's global tax position while maintaining full regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with Finance and Operations leadership to assess the tax implications of business initiatives, transactions, organizational changes, and geographic expansion efforts.
* Provide guidance and recommendations on indirect tax matters impacting the business.

**Entity Management & Compliance**

* Oversee relationships with registered agent service providers for domestic and international legal entities.
* Research complex indirect tax issues, develop taxability guidance for products and services, and review contractual tax provisions.
* Maintain accurate records of the firm's corporate entity structure, including subsidiaries and international branch operations.
* Ensure entity-level compliance requirements are tracked and completed in a timely manner.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Accounting, Finance, IT, Procurement, Payroll, and Sales Operations teams to address tax-related reporting requirements and operational impacts.
* Support the implementation of new business initiatives, system integrations, and process improvements from a tax compliance perspective.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on tax matters affecting business decisions and strategic initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities by Reporting Cycle:**

**Monthly**

* Reconcile tax-related accounts and maintain supporting documentation for financial reporting.
* Manage sales tax compliance through Avalara, including filings and payments.
* Coordinate with Payroll to verify payroll tax filings and remittances.
* Review and maintain tax compliance calendars and filing deadlines.
* Liaise with registered agent service providers to ensure completion of annual reports and ongoing entity obligations.

**Quarterly**

* Prepare and submit tax filings across applicable federal, state, and international jurisdictions.
* Review transfer pricing arrangements and coordinate updates to intercompany agreements, as needed.
* Support private equity sponsor reporting requirements, including responses to tax-related investor inquiries.

**Annually**

* Manage preparation and filing of corporate income tax returns across all applicable jurisdictions.
* Oversee year-end tax account reconciliations and provision-to-return adjustments.
* Lead preparation of documentation related to annual business licenses, franchise taxes, and entity compliance requirements.
* Coordinate annual transfer pricing studies and documentation updates with external advisors.
* Prepare executive-level reporting summarizing tax compliance activities, key risks, and planning opportunities.

**AI Utilization & Development**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of firm-approved AI-enabled solutions in accordance with company policies, professional standards, data protection requirements, and intellectual property guidelines.
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies and identify compliant opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and operational effectiveness across tax and compliance processes.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of corporate tax experience, preferably within a private equity-backed organization, professional services firm, or consulting environment.
* Deep expertise in multi-jurisdictional tax compliance and reporting, including international tax requirements.
* Strong knowledge of transfer pricing principles, regulations, and documentation requirements.
* Exceptional organizational, project management, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Ability to execute detailed and complex processes in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Advanced proficiency with accounting ERP systems, including Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Excel.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience with tax compliance platforms such as Avalara.
* Comfort with AI and a demonstrated ability to responsibly adopt firm-approved tools to enhance productivity and innovation.
* A continuous learning mindset and interest in emerging technologies, automation, and process improvement.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* CPA or equivalent professional certification strongly preferred.

description:

Jersey Mike’s is a fast-casual sub sandwich franchise with over 3,300 locations nationwide, offering fresh sliced subs, grilled-to-order and freshly baked bread. You’ll leverage customer transactional, loyalty, and behavioral data to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and deepen understanding of our customers. The ideal candidate is a highly curious, self-motivated analyst who thrives on exploring data, asking the right questions, and uncovering meaningful insights that go beyond the numbers. * Translate complex analyses into concise, actionable recommendations for business leaders.

* Analyze large-scale customer transaction, loyalty, and behavioral datasets to uncover insights into customer acquisition, retention, purchasing behavior, and lifetime value.

* Identify the key drivers of customer behavior and business performance using rigorous quantitative analysis.

* Help establish best practices for customer analytics and reporting as the Customer Insights function continues to grow.

* 3–6 years of experience in Customer Insights, Consumer Insights, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a related analytical role.
* Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying large relational databases.
* Experience analyzing customer-level transaction, loyalty, CRM, or behavioral data to generate actionable business insights.
* Working knowledge of statistical methods commonly used in customer analytics, including regression analysis, driver analysis, correlation analysis, hypothesis testing, significance testing, and trend analysis.
* Experience building, owning, and maintaining dashboards and recurring reporting using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.

description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a Principal Product Manager to own billing and platform at Constant Contact. This is a rare chance to shape one of the most connected systems in the company. Almost every team has a stake in billing, and you will be the person who brings their needs together into one clear strategy and a medium- to long-term roadmap. Success in this role comes from smart decisions, a smooth move to Stripe, and a billing platform the business trusts and can evolve quickly.

Billing is how every Constant Contact product turns into revenue, and hundreds of thousands of small businesses count on it. We are moving our billing from an in-house system to Stripe. At the same time, we are modernizing the platform every customer touches: how they sign in, what their plan lets them do, and the internal tools Finance and Support use to run the business.

You'll partner with our Billing Infrastructure and Growth & Enablement engineering teams, and work closely with Finance, FP&A, RevOps, Support, Sales and our Growth PMs.

The ideal candidate knows how money moves through a subscription business, is technical enough to shape engineering decisions, and is strategic enough to guide stakeholders and set direction.

* **Own Billing & Payments Strategy:** Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for subscriptions, plans and pricing, invoicing, payment methods, payment recovery, refunds and account changes. Decide what we build, in what order, and why.
* **Lead the Move to Stripe:** Own our migration from an in-house billing system to Stripe Billing, including phasing, success metrics, testing, cutover and sign-off. Deliver a seamless experience for every customer.
* **Make Pricing Changes Simple and Fast:** Make price changes, new plans and add-ons quick and easy to launch. Keep what a customer pays for in step with what the product lets them do.
* **Own Identity & Authentication:** Partner with Engineering and Security on sign-in, single sign-on (SSO), account access and the identity platform behind them.
* **Modernize Internal Applications:** Own the tools Finance, Support and Operations use to adjust bills, issue refunds and migrate accounts. Bring automation to the work these teams do every day.
* **Lead Across Stakeholders:** Be the product lead for Finance, FP&A, RevOps, Support and Sales. Set priorities across them, explain trade-offs clearly and build alignment around the plan.
* **Make Billing Data Trustworthy:** Define how billing works across our systems so reporting and revenue always line up. Support revenue recognition, audits and access controls.
* **Raise the Bar:** Mentor other product managers and help set how product works across billing and platform teams.

### **Who You Are**

* **An Experienced Platform Product Leader:** You have 8+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, with at least 4 years owning billing, payments, subscription commerce or a core platform.

You have worked with Stripe or a comparable platform such as Zuora, Chargebee, Recurly or Adyen. You understand how these platforms work under the hood.

* **Rigorous and Detail-Oriented:** You have shipped a migration, cutover or pricing change with real customer and revenue stakes. You plan testing, rollback and controls from the start.
* **A Clear Communicator:** You can explain a billing trade-off to an executive, a support agent and an engineer, and each of them gets it.
* **AI-Native and Curious:** You already use AI tools to research, analyze data and move faster. It is part of how you work today.

### **Nice to Have**

* Led a migration from an in-house or legacy billing system to Stripe or another modern platform.
* Identity and access experience: Okta, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SSO or multi-factor authentication.
* Experience in a high-volume, self-serve SMB subscription business.
* Partner or reseller billing, where a third party bills the customer.
* Finance systems experience: ERP, CPQ, revenue recognition or SOX controls.
* Experience mentoring senior PMs.

* We own outcomes.
* We plan for the medium and long term and focus on what matters most.
* We hold a high bar for billing accuracy.
* We build in testing, rollback and controls from day one.
* We solve problems at the root.

* Manage campaign targeting, bidding, budgets, pacing, and retargeting strategies.
* Collaborate with Event Marketing and Studio to develop compelling messaging, advertising copy, and campaign assets.
* Test audiences, offers, creative, and landing pages and channels to improve conversion rates and campaign effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through emerging tools and marketing technologies.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
**Shape the Next Chapter of Achievement First**
-----------------------------------------------

What does it take to make 41 schools work exceptionally well, every day, while rebuilding the systems that support them? Achievement First is seeking a Chief Operating Officer who can bring simplicity to complexity, set a high bar for operational execution, and lead the work of building a stronger, more integrated network. This is an opportunity for an executive who finds purpose in demanding, consequential work and knows how to turn operational challenges into lasting institutional strength.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Founded in 1999, Achievement First Public Charter Schools is a nonprofit network of 41 public charter schools serving approximately 15,000 students across Connecticut, New York, and Rhode Island. Our mission is to prepare every student to excel in college and career, deepen their knowledge of self and community, and lead lives of purpose. In partnership with families and communities, we work to disrupt the legacy of inequity in education and believe deeply in the unlimited potential of every student.

Achievement First is renewing academic excellence through a redesign of its K–12 instructional program. At the same time, the environment for public education is changing: families have evolving expectations and more options, and schools must deliver compelling experiences while managing cost, regulation, facilities, and technology. Internally, the network's growth outpaced the development of some central systems and shared operating practices, leaving uneven processes and insufficiently codified standards. AF has recently moved to a more decentralized model in which Regional Executive Directors lead regional academics and operations, and the COO sets networkwide standards and drives consistent performance through strong functional leadership and regional partnership.

The COO reports to the Chief Executive Officer and serves on the Executive Leadership Team. The role owns a portfolio spanning facilities and real estate, school operations support, student enrollment, operational risk, and Information, Technology, and Data, with an approximately $45 million budget, 4 direct reports and 42 positions. Regional executives retain direct authority over regional operations teams, so the COO leads through shared standards, clear performance expectations, and defined executive and regional decision channels. The next COO will inherit real strengths to build upon, alongside work that needs to be simplified, codified, and redesigned. This leader will set the operating vision, make disciplined choices about internal capability and external partnerships, and will turn fragmented practices into reliable, repeatable systems without losing momentum in schools.

The opportunity is demanding and consequential: enables the daily experience of students and educators while building the operational bedrock for durable performance and future scale. Achievement First needs a leader energized by creating a clear path where there is ambiguity, capable of making hard tradeoffs, and skilled at bringing people on the change journey. Success will depend on the ability to own results, lead specialized experts and vendors, challenge colleagues, and create coherence across a complex organization.

**What You Will Lead**

Oath is the strategic giving platform designed to help donors maximize the impact of their contributions by guiding them to the races and causes where their dollars can make the greatest impact. Oath has directed over $150M while protecting donors' data and avoiding the spam and spin of other giving platforms. As the one stop shop for a generation of donors who want to make a difference, Oath is building the future of philanthropy.

The Partnerships team owns Oath's relationships with the organizations that move money at scale: PACs, donor networks, party committees, and bundlers. description:
**Job Description:** Director Trade Marketing (LDB)
  
**Job Title:** Director, Trade Marketing
  
**Division:** L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB)
  
**Reports To:** AVP, Trade Marketing
  
  
**Location:** Hudson Yards, NY
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Trade Marketing team at L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB) operates as the critical commercial engine and strategic bridge between our world-class brands—CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy—and our retail partners. We do not simply execute plans; we are the architects of the commercial strategy. We translate high-level national brand visions into concrete, localized, and winning trade architectures that dictate how our portfolio dominates at the shelf and on the screen.
  
  
We are looking for a powerhouse leader to step into the role of AVP, Trade Marketing. This is not a role for those who seek the path of least resistance. It is a high-visibility, high-stakes position that requires an individual with exceptional grit, an unshakeable work ethic, and a commanding professional presence. You will lead the charge in bridging marketing ambition with commercial reality, serving as a highly reliable, deeply trusted partner to both internal teams and retail giants.
  
  
The Opportunity & Your Impact
  
  
As the AVP of Trade Marketing, you will lead a high-performing team tasked with translating each brand's national strategy and defining the overarching commercial strategy for the division. You will be the ultimate owner of how CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy show up commercially, establishing the promotional guardrails, trade spending efficiency parameters, and go-to-market execution plans.
  
  
This role demands a leader who is not afraid to go toe-to-toe with General Managers, Brand Presidents, and Marketing heads. You will be the voice of commercial reality, backed by bulletproof, data-driven analytics. When tough conversations are needed regarding how national strategies must adapt to the retail landscape, or when commercial parameters must be strictly defined, you will lean in with confidence, facts, and a solution-oriented attitude.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For:** Our Future Leader
  
  
We are searching for a relentless driver who brings a masterclass balance of strategic marketing translation, commercial street-smarts, and analytic rigor. You are someone who:
  

* Is a Strategic Translator: You can look at a national brand marketing plan and immediately identify how to operationalize it into a commercial strategy that retailers buy into.
* Possesses Deep Grit: You roll up your sleeves, thrive in fast-paced complexity, and view obstacles as puzzles to be solved. You are resilient, reliable, and run toward challenges, not away from them.
* Commands the Room: You have a strong, authentic leadership style and an executive presence that immediately builds trust.
* Engages in Constructive Friction: You are comfortable speaking truth to power. You are fearless in challenging GMs, Sales leaders, and Marketers to ensure our trade strategies are both commercially sound and highly profitable.
* Is Rooted in Data: Your opinions are strong, but they are always backed by objective, meticulous analytics. You are a trusted source of truth because you let the data do the heavy lifting.

Key Job Responsibilities
  

* Define Commercial Strategy for one of our two mass brands: Serve as the chief architect in translating brand-specific national strategies into a unified, high-performing divisional commercial strategy across all key retail channels.
* Translate National Brand Ambition: Act as the strategic conduit between Brand Marketing and Sales. Take national campaigns and product launches and translate them into commercially viable retail programs for CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy.
* Commercial Guardrail Ownership: Establish and enforce rigorous divisional trade guidelines. Collaborate cross-functionally (Divisional Leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Finance) to align brand ambitions with commercial realities and strict ROI parameters.
* Fearless Stakeholder Management: Act as the strategic partner and challenger to GMs and Brand Teams. Drive the tough, necessary alignments on promotional ROI, pricing executions, and commercial trade spend when national strategies clash with field realities.
* Bulletproof Analytical Storytelling: Translate complex retailer, consumer, and financial data into clear, persuasive strategic narratives. Deliver high-impact presentations to executive leadership.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing Trade Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous development.
* P&L and ROI Optimization: Maintain a deep, precise understanding of the divisional P&L. Rigorously analyze promotional ROI and trade spend efficiency to identify and capture profit-improvement opportunities.
* Retailer & Field Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with Field Sales and Customer Marketing to ensure our defined commercial plans are flawlessly executed, highly competitive, and customized to win across the retailer landscape.

Background & Experience Requirements
  
  
**Educational Background:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Commercial Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related business field. MBA is a plus.

**Professional Experience & Technical Skills:**  

* 7-12+ years of experience working in a fast-paced FMCG or CPG organization, with a strong preference for deep exposure to Trade Marketing, Commercial Strategy, or Category Management.
* Experienced managerial skills with multiple direct reports and upscaling junior talent
* Strategic Translation Track Record: Proven experience taking high-level brand ideas/national strategies and successfully mapping them into commercial, retailer-facing programs.
* Proven Leadership: A track record of leading teams and directly influencing senior, multi-functional leadership.
* Commercial Acumen: A deep understanding of the US retailer landscape, trade spend mechanics, and how brand marketing strategies translate to the retail shelf.
* Financial Literacy: Strong command of product financial structures and P&L dynamics; capability to evaluate the financial health of trade investments.
* Analytical Rigor: Hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets to derive actionable insights. Familiarity with syndicated data sources (Circana/IRI, Numerator, Nielsen) and trade promotion management tools.
* Technical Proficiency: High comfort level with data visualization and analytics tools (Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to build data-backed arguments.

**Salary range:** $138K-$200K

**Position Summary:**  
  
We have an exciting opening for a Senior Data Analyst within the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicine, Research Division. In this role, the successful candidate will work under the direction of Principal Investigator and Medical Director for Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Dr. Ula Hwang. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting data management and analyses using clinical, administrative, and operational data, and for planning, designing, and implementing statistical analyses. This will include working with large national and multicenter research network databases, including electronic health record (EHR) and claims data. The individual in this position will support multiple projects in day-to-day activities, including preliminary data analysis, data visualization, predictive and machine learning analytics, causal inference analyses, and results dissemination. All research and programming code must be regularly documented and archived per best practices. Other responsibilities will include coordinating and participating in regular meetings that pertain to data preparation, management, analyses and ongoing research projects. The analyst will communicate information and data in written and verbal form to colleagues as well as project and senior management teams. A successful applicant will be a strong communicator, be curious, inquisitive and resourceful, have a high degree of professional maturity and commitment to excellence, and be able to work autonomously and comfortably on a health services research team in an academic medical center environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Demonstrates knowledge of the organizations Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.

Under the supervision of research faculty, analyzes, develops, and interprets scientific results. Maintains clear documentation of analyses, including well-documented, version-controlled and reproducible code and analytic workflows. Presents findings to the research team and collaborators.  
Supports the development of publications and conference presentations, including drafting academic and non-academic publications and creating tables, figures, and other data visualizations for presentations.  
May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
To qualify you must have a Bachelors Degree and 3-5 years of experience required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Masters degree in a scientific discipline such as statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science, or health economics, and at least 3-5 years of experience in a relevant setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  
Strong quantitative skills and advanced programming skills in R, Python, SAS, and/or Stata.  
Experience working with EHR clinical data and/or CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.  
Ability to select and apply appropriate statistical methods for collecting, summarizing, and analyzing EHR and other large datasets.  
Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.  
Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative research team.  
Knowledge of principles and methods of biostatistics and epidemiology, including study design, statistical analysis, and causal inference.  
Experience with database queries and SQL, version control systems (e.g., Git/Github), and familiarity with healthcare coding systems and standards (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, NDC)

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

The postholder will drive CRM discipline, data quality, reporting and dashboarding, while providing insight on conversion, must-win priorities, recompete exposure, concentration and pipeline risk. The role will turn pipeline data into clear management information that supports governance, financial alignment and action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipeline Data Quality & CRM Discipline**
------------------------------------------

Maintain a complete, accurate and trusted enterprise pipeline by applying agreed data, stage and governance standards. Work directly with opportunity owners to resolve gaps and ensure records reflect the current position.

* Monitor Salesforce and associated pipeline records for completeness, accuracy, currency and consistency.
* Validate opportunity value, stage, timing, probability, ownership, next steps and supporting evidence.
* Follow up missing or overdue updates with opportunity owners and track resolution of data-quality issues.
* Apply agreed pipeline definitions, entry and exit criteria and mandatory data standards.
* Produce data-quality reports and identify recurring control or adoption issues.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

Produce clear, reliable management information that gives leaders visibility of pipeline value, maturity, movement and risk. Maintain dashboards and reporting packs that support action and decision-making.

* Prepare regular pipeline dashboards, KPI reports, review packs and executive summaries.
* Report pipeline value by stage, geography, service line, customer, owner and expected decision date.
* Highlight material movements, stalled opportunities, overdue actions and changes in assumptions.
* Maintain consistent reporting logic, definitions and reconciliations across reports.
* Improve reporting efficiency through appropriate dashboarding, automation and standard templates.

**Pipeline Reviews & Governance Support**
-----------------------------------------

Coordinate the information and analysis required for effective pipeline governance. Ensure review forums have accurate records, clear actions and timely follow-through.

* Prepare agendas, analysis and opportunity information for pipeline and portfolio reviews.
* Identify records that do not meet qualification, evidence or stage-gate requirements.
* Capture decisions, actions, owners and deadlines arising from governance reviews.
* Monitor agreed actions and escalate unresolved data or process issues to the Director.
* Maintain the governance calendar and supporting documentation.

**Prioritization & Portfolio Analysis**
---------------------------------------

Provide analysis that supports evidence-based opportunity prioritization and must-win management. Help leaders understand pipeline balance, resource implications and alignment with growth strategy.

* Maintain prioritization scores, must-win reporting and portfolio views using agreed criteria.
* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.
* Prepare analytical inputs for resource allocation and investment discussions.
* Track whether priority opportunities continue to meet the evidence required for their status.

**Conversion, Win/Loss & Performance Insight**
----------------------------------------------

Track how opportunities progress through the lifecycle and identify where conversion is improving or weakening. Convert performance data into practical insight for governance and continuous improvement.

* Calculate and monitor stage conversion, win rates, pipeline velocity and ageing using agreed definitions.
* Analyze bottlenecks, stalled opportunities and patterns in progression or attrition.
* Support win/loss reviews by preparing data, trends and opportunity histories.
* Compare performance across relevant portfolio dimensions without overstating conclusions.
* Produce concise recommendations and follow-up measures arising from analysis.

**Recompete, Concentration & Pipeline Risk Insight**
----------------------------------------------------

Maintain visibility of contract expiry, recompete exposure, concentration and other risks that may affect future growth. Provide early warning of coverage gaps and changes that require management action.

* Maintain the recompete and contract-expiry view and reconcile it with the active pipeline.
* Monitor pipeline maturity, probability, timing, dependencies and key risk indicators.
* Analyze exposure by commissioner, funder, contract, market, geography and service line.
* Identify future revenue gaps, weak pipeline coverage and material changes in portfolio risk.
* Support scenario and mitigation analysis with Finance, Growth and Opportunity Management.

**Forecast Reconciliation & Continuous Improvement**
----------------------------------------------------

Support alignment between pipeline information and financial planning while improving the quality and efficiency of pipeline processes. Provide transparent analysis of differences, assumptions and changes.

* Support regular reconciliation of pipeline assumptions with FP&A forecasts and planning data.
* Maintain clear records of timing, probability and value assumptions used in reporting.
* Investigate material differences between CRM records, governance reports and financial views.
* Support scenario analysis and long-range growth planning with accurate pipeline data.
* Identify and implement improvements to data standards, reports, controls and user guidance.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting

* Strong data-analysis capability with advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

* Ability to identify trends, exceptions and risks and explain them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
