description:
**ABOUT FANDUEL**

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a **Sports Trader** to join our **Trading Team**, helping to shape the odds and betting markets that customers engage with. We're looking for someone with a passion for Football (NFL or NCAAF) or Hockey. They will also need some fundamental knowledge of NBA to help with live trading.

Whether you have a numbers background, have studied analytics, worked in sports, or are just obsessed with Football or Hockey, we'd love to support your growth into a trading role. No prior trading or gambling experience is required.

This is a hybrid position with office presence required in Jersey City, NJ (just across the river from Manhattan). In this role, expect to be predominantly in-office for hands-on training and core Trading tasks. The office contains an open space with a hot-desk environment. Each station has multiple monitors and there are TVs and constant noise in the office. You'll also work regular late shifts (typically 2:30pm–10:30pm ET) during the NBA season, which will include assisting the team with live basketball betting. This role requires weekend work.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined below, employees may occasionally be asked to support other duties in line with evolving business needs and their preferences.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**
  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

As a Sports Trader, you'll start by learning the core skills that power our odds and markets. You'll receive hands-on training in how sports betting works, how we use models and data to manage prices, and how we monitor news and customer behavior to keep our pricing sharp.

Your day-to-day will include:

* Learning to set and manage prices on football or hockey games, player stats, and futures markets — from pre-game to live in-play odds — using our in-house tools and models.
* Monitoring real-time news, stats, and industry pricing to help guide trading decisions.
* Trading live games in real time; making quick adjustments to pricing based on game flow, key events, and customer behavior.
* Collaborating with other Traders and working cross-functionally with Risk, Product, Marketing, and Compliance teams in a cooperative and inclusive environment.
* Helping brainstorm new bet types or ways to improve the customer experience, with consideration for how fans engage with the game.

You'll work alongside experienced Traders who will guide your development. Over time, you'll gain the confidence and expertise to price markets independently, manage risk, and shape the sports betting experience for our customers.

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* A deep passion for either NFL, NCAAF or Hockey (especially the NHL, but other leagues is a plus).
* General knowledge of other sports, ideally NBA for live market management, and MLB or WNBA for trading during the Football/NHL offseason.
* A bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience. Recent or soon-to-be graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong comfort with numbers, odds and probability, and quick mental math skills.
* It's important to understand how odds relate to probability (%), and how betting markets work in that sense. You do not have to bet yourself.
* Proficiency with Excel. Experience with SQL, Python, or R is a bonus, but not required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, plus the curiosity to research and stay ahead of news and trends.

**Job Description**

About the Agency:  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
Your Team  
  
The Disaster Recovery Grant Manager will be a key member of the Compliance & Strategy Team within the agency’s Office of Compliance & Risk Management (CRM). This office includes various compliance, oversight, and hearing functions to ensure fairness, consistency, and equity in both our external and internal engagement. CRM collaborates with programs across HPD to ensure the agency and its partners comply with laws (federal, state, and city), regulatory requirements, policies, and procedures. The Office includes the following Divisions and units:  

* Compliance & Strategy
* Economic Opportunity & Regulatory Compliance
* Audit Support
* Adjudications
* Public Information

  
Your Impact  
  
CRM is responsible for overseeing the agency’s compliance and risk management functions, liaising with the units and staff responsible for relevant compliance responsibilities, audit responses, site standard adherence for financed construction work, public-facing appeals and hearings, and managing risk for the agency. The Disaster Recovery Grant Manager will be responsible for supporting teams across the agency in managing programs funded by grants received by HPD, with a specific focus on Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) grants [NJ2.1][GM2.2]provided by the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) after a qualifying disaster, such as Hurricanes Sandy and Ida.  
  
Your Role  
  
Reporting to the Executive Director of Compliance & Strategy, the Disaster Recovery Grant Manager will manage cross-agency programmatic and reporting obligations, assist with policies and procedures, and provide technical assistance for CDBG-DR[NJ3.1][GM3.2] grant funded programs within HPD. The person in this role will work closely and liaise with Offices and Divisions throughout HPD, as well as external partners.  
  
Your Responsibilities  
  
The Disaster Recovery Grant Manager will:  

* Coordinate between programs administering CDBG grant funds across the agency as well as external partners, which may include the NYC Office of Management & Budget (OMB), NYC Housing Recovery Operations (HRO), NYC Law Department (Law), NYC Mayor’s Office of Climate and Environmental Justice (MOCEJ), and HUD.
* Carry out the infrastructure already set in place for monitoring, documenting, and reporting internal, contractors’, and subrecipients’ compliance with all applicable governing regulations for CDBG-DR [NJ4.1]programs and help implement for new CDBG-DR programs.

* Collaborate with administrative and program staff in the implementation of plans, policies, and strategies to ensure effective compliance with federal and program policies, including but not limited to the Offices of Neighborhood Strategies (ONS), Development (DEV), Asset & Property Management (APM), Policy & Strategy (OPS), Finance & Administration (OFA), and Legal Affairs (OLA).
* Provide guidance and resources to HPD staff and contracted parties on requirements and ensure execution in accordance with regulations, including:

o Develop policies and procedures and training manuals/tools  
o Assist program oversight of vendor management of partners, including providing technical and procedural guidance in line with program terms, policies, and federal guidelines.  
o Assist programs with retaining and maintaining audit-ready records  

* Coordinate and communicate with the Office of Finance & Administration to ensure that funding levels and budgetary requirements are followed appropriately as well as:

o Troubleshoot CDBG-DR funding-related issues as they arise; track disbursement of funds  
o Track expenditures and vendor compliance  

* Conduct risk analyses to identify potential compliance concerns and possible internal control processes within the procedures, operation of programs, and delivery of services, with the assistance of NYC OMB, Law, and/or other experts; Develop a set of best practices, as necessary to mitigate risks.
* Provide information to external parties including:

o Documentation to support drawdowns for OMB  
o Assist with data requests and regular reporting related to CDBG-DR funded programs, including requests related to program status, vendor selection and performance, and budget activity.  
o Work with HPD’s Audit Support team for external audits, monitoring, or investigations of HPD CDBG-DR funded programs; recommend corrective action plans, and ensure that corrective actions have been implemented;  
  
A cover letter is required. Please submit a cover letter as part of your application.  
  
Preferred Skills  
The ideal candidate will be an inquisitive self-starter and problem-solver with demonstrated leadership skills in the field of compliance, risk management, and/or grant monitoring. They will be eager to utilize and share their expertise, setting the foundation for long term agency compliance and a risk management framework. They should have proven experience and skills:

Minimum Qualifications  
Candidates must meet the qualifications of Administrative Staff Analyst and have a minimum of five years in relevant and related roles demonstrating successful project management capacity and increasing levels of responsibility.  
  
Note: This position is eligible for remote work up to two days per week, pursuant to the Remote Work Pilot Program agreed to between the City and OSA.

title: AI-Enabled Business Analyst
description:
**Technology & Analytics | The Builders and Translators**

We are a 1,000-piece puzzle. Each of us is essential, interconnected, and intentionally designed. Together, we create something powerful: media that matters, growth that lasts, and a culture we are proud to build.

As part of our Technology & Analytics team, you are one of the Builders and Translators, turning complex data, emerging technologies, and innovative ideas into practical solutions that help our entire agency work smarter. You connect human expertise with the power of technology, finding smarter ways to use data, simplify processes, and help our people make better decisions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

At Attention Arc, we believe technology should amplify human expertise, not replace it.

As our **AI-Enabled Business Analyst**, you'll combine analytical thinking, data expertise, business curiosity, and practical knowledge of AI to improve how our agency operates.

You'll work directly with department leaders, managers, and employees to understand how work actually gets done. You'll ask thoughtful questions, map workflows, examine decision points, and identify opportunities to simplify processes, connect data, and eliminate repetitive work.

This role is different from a traditional media analyst position. While our client-facing analysts focus on account-specific challenges and performance, you'll focus on opportunities that benefit the broader agency. You'll look for recurring challenges across teams and clients, then help develop solutions that can be reused, scaled, and continuously improved.

You'll work with data from multiple systems, write SQL queries, use platforms such as Snowflake, and apply AI tools to make information more accessible and useful. Whether you're combining three datasets into one reliable reporting process, improving a planning calculator, or helping a team develop better AI prompts, your focus will be on solving real business problems.

You don't need to be a full-stack software developer. You do need to be comfortable working with data, understanding technical systems, learning new tools, and translating business needs into practical solutions.

Most importantly, you'll be curious enough to ask why a process exists, thoughtful enough to understand the decisions behind it, and resourceful enough to find a better way.

Your impact will be measured by the clarity you create, the time you save, the processes you improve, and the value your solutions bring to people across Attention Arc.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Business Workflow Discovery & Process Optimization**

* Meet with department leaders, managers, and employees to understand their daily responsibilities, recurring tasks, operational challenges, and business objectives.
* Analyze existing workflows to identify manual processes, duplicated effort, inefficiencies, disconnected systems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, and decision trees that document how work moves through the agency and how decisions are made.
* Ask thoughtful questions to uncover the underlying business problem rather than simply automating an existing process.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify processes across departments and client teams.
* Translate business challenges into clear requirements for data solutions, AI applications, workflow automations, and process improvements.
* Evaluate potential solutions based on feasibility, expected time savings, accuracy, scalability, and business impact.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to test proposed improvements and ensure solutions fit how employees actually work.

**Data Analysis, Integration & Optimization**

* Work with data from multiple internal and external sources to support agency-wide operational improvements.
* Use SQL and Snowflake to query, join, transform, validate, and organize datasets.
* Combine information from multiple sources into consolidated datasets, reports, or workflows that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
* Identify opportunities to simplify recurring data preparation, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
* Analyze data structures and relationships to understand how information flows between systems.
* Build and improve data-driven tools, calculators, templates, and reporting processes that support business decision-making.
* Support the development of reusable data models and standardized reporting approaches that can benefit multiple departments or client teams.
* Investigate data quality issues, inconsistent definitions, missing information, and process gaps that affect reporting or operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Technology colleagues on more complex integrations and data infrastructure needs.
* Document data sources, transformation logic, calculations, and assumptions to support accuracy and repeatability.

**AI Enablement & Prompt Optimization**

* Identify practical opportunities to use generative AI and large language models (LLMs) to improve agency workflows.
* Work with teams to understand the inputs, business context, rules, and desired outputs needed for effective AI-assisted processes.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts that help employees complete recurring tasks more consistently and efficiently.
* Create structured prompt templates, instructions, and repeatable AI-assisted workflows for common business needs.
* Partner with Media Planning and other departments to explore how AI can support research, information synthesis, plan development, reporting, and operational tasks.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, consistency, usefulness, and alignment with business requirements.
* Help determine when AI is an appropriate solution and when better data organization, process redesign, or conventional automation would be more effective.
* Explore tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, and other relevant AI platforms.
* Document successful AI use cases and help make them accessible to employees across the agency.
* Apply responsible AI practices, including appropriate human review, data privacy, and information security.

**Workflow Automation & Business Solutions**

title: Senior HR & Benefits Analyst
description:
The Senior HR & Benefits Specialist supports the day-to-day administration of Family Office Management (FOM) human resources and employee benefit programs. The position is responsible for accurate and timely processing of employee lifecycle events, benefit plan administration, billing, and reconciliation, HRA and COBRA support, retirement plan activities, and client service. **Primary Responsibilities:**

**Employee Lifecycle Administration**

* Process client new-hire requests; prepare and distribute required onboarding information; follow up on outstanding items; and maintain accurate employee personnel files.
* Process client termination requests; prepare and distribute required termination information; complete follow-up activities; and maintain accurate employee files.
* Respond to and follow up on unemployment verification requests involving client employees.
* Review payroll activity to confirm that new hires, terminations, employee changes, leaves of absence, disability events, and related benefit changes are reflected accurately.

**Client and Employee Support**

* Respond to day-to-day benefit plan questions from Client Advisors (CAs), clients, and client employees.
* Research client, client employee, and CA inquiries and prepare clear summaries of findings and recommended next steps, as appropriate.

**HRA Administration**

* Administer client Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) plans and maintain accurate eligibility and plan information.
* Remind eligible employees to submit HRA claims and assist with claim-submission issues.
* Perform quarterly HRA account reviews and analyze claims paid and account activity.
* Update HRA records for annual enrollment, plan design changes, new hires, and terminations.

**COBRA Administration**

* Administer stand-alone COBRA plans for assigned clients.
* Monitor COBRA participation and ensure records reflect plan design changes, new enrollments, terminations, coverage start dates, and coverage end dates.
* Coordinate and track required COBRA communications and follow-up items with vendors and affected participants.

**Benefit Plan Billing and Reconciliation**

* Process monthly invoices for client health plans, individual benefit plans, and FOM payroll vendors.
* Maintain billing tracking logs to confirm that invoices are current and paid on a timely basis.
* Reconcile medical and benefit invoices to payroll and employee headcount records; investigate and resolve discrepancies with carriers, providers, and vendors.

**Retirement and Savings Plan Support**

* Assist with year-end 401(k) census preparation and related plan testing and Form 5500 support for client review.
* Serve as backup for 401(k) plan funding from payroll to plan administrators.
* Serve as backup for monitoring outstanding 401(k) plan loans, reconciling loan repayments to payroll, and confirming that deductions end when required.
* Support administration of supplemental IRAs and state-mandated retirement programs, as assigned.

**Operational and Administrative Support**

* Review and update new-hire and termination checklists as needed.
* Provide documentation and support for internal audits.
* Assist with client setup on new vendor platforms, including COBRA and HRA administration systems.
* Maintain complete, current, and accurate client and employee files daily.
* Review departmental processes and recommend improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and service.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of five years of progressive human resources and/or employee benefits experience.
* Working knowledge of employee benefit administration and applicable compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate “generalist” understanding of HR with strong ability to source solutions to unique HR issues.
* Experience with leave administration and legal requirements around leaves at a federal and state level.
* Demonstrates an understanding of medical plan administration, HRA administration, and COBRA is a plus.
* HR certifications are a plus – SHRM or HRCI.

* Strong analytical, reconciliation, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and client requests in a demanding environment.

The Office of Chief Medical Examiner investigates cases of persons who die within New York City from criminal violence, by accident, by suicide, suddenly when in apparent health, when unattended by a physician, in a correctional facility or in any suspicious or unusual manner or where an application is made pursuant to law for a permit to cremate a body of a person.

The Drug Intelligence and Intervention Group (DIIG) at OCME was created for the joint purposes of:
  
  
1. Tracking suspected and confirmed overdose deaths,
  
  
2. Providing public sector leaders with timely and actionable information about fatal overdose, and
  
  
3. Providing direct support to family and friends of overdose victims in NYC.
  
  
DIIG conducts public health surveillance of overdose, collecting and leveraging data before and after OCME has determined cause and manner of death. Intervention Group. Lead and supervise a team of epidemiologists, data analysts, and support staff in the collection, management, and analysis of overdose-related data.
  
  
Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data systems to improve overdose mortality surveillance and reporting.

Ensure compliance with legal, ethical, and regulatory standards for death investigation data and protected health information.
  
  
Spearhead innovative approaches to identifying emerging overdose trends through mortality data analytics.

Success is defined by delivering high-quality projects on time and maintaining clear, transparent visibility into overall department status.

#### **What You'll Own**

* **Workstream visibility.** Maintain one view of cross-departmental initiatives: owners, status, dependencies and risks, with Jira as the source of truth. Run regular check-ins that keep it honest, raise concerns before they become surprises, and give leadership a clear picture of what is moving and what is not.
* **Ad-hoc and flagship projects.** Take projects from brief to delivery: agree scope and owners, build the plan, chase the dependencies, manage the timeline and run the follow-up.
* **Company moments such as SKO and Forge Partner Day.** Support the Partnerships contribution to events where the department is on stage. This may include working with leadership on the narrative and theme, briefing speakers, gathering content from pillar leads and coordinating with Marketing and Events.
* **Cross-functional initiatives.** Drive initiatives that cut across teams and need a single owner for delivery, such as moving a process from one team to another or launching a change that touches several pillars. Clarify who does what, keep the work moving and close it out properly.
* **Operating rhythm.** Support the department's OKRs, monthly and quarterly business reviews, quarterly narratives and monthly All Hands. Build the trackers and templates, chase inputs, prepare pre-reads and help run the sessions, so that leaders spend their time on decisions.
* **Communications and PR-FAQs.** Support the cadence of department updates and the PR-FAQ tracker for major launches, so that format, tone and timing stay consistent and status is honest.
* **Planning and engagement.** Support the SVP, Partnerships and Partner Operations team with annual planning, and the follow-up from the employee engagement survey in Culture Amp: tracking actions through to completion and reporting back on what changed.
* **Salesforce alignment.** If the acquisition of Braze by Salesforce completes, help plan and track the work to bring the Braze partner program in line with the broader Salesforce partner program and ecosystem, and keep it visible alongside everything else in flight.

#### **What This Role Is Really About**

A department our size can't hire a specialist for every function, and shouldn't. What it needs is someone who can pick up whatever matters most this month, run it properly and leave something behind that works without them. One month that is the narrative and run of show for Forge Partner Day. The next it is an initiative that three teams each assume another team owns. The through-line is visibility: whatever you are working on, people can see where it stands.

You will not own the content or the decisions. Pillar leads own their numbers and their stories, and leadership owns the choices. You own the delivery and the clarity around it. That means asking the question that exposes a gap in a plan, noticing when a deadline will slip a week before it does, and telling a leader that their narrative buries the lead. You do this without formal authority, and you earn trust by making everyone else's job easier.

You will also see things that are sensitive: survey results, plans in progress, changes to the organisation. Discretion is part of the job.

#### **How We Show Up**

* **Drives ownership to completion.** You step in to claim unassigned initiatives, assign clear accountability, and steer them through to successful execution.

* **Ensures end-to-end transparency.** You maintain clear and dependable tracking of progress, status, and risks, flagging delays early alongside practical solutions.
* **Leads through influence and trust.** You motivate senior leaders to hit deadlines by making collaboration seamless and consistently delivering value.
* **Balances strategy with tactical detail.** You seamlessly transition from managing detailed operational schedules to briefing executives on complex cross-functional dependencies.
* **Upholds strict confidentiality.** You handle sensitive and unreleased information with complete discretion and earn executive trust.

#### **Who You Are**

* Has driven cross-functional programs from brief to delivery with several stakeholders and senior people, and has run events or company moments with speakers, content and a tight timeline
* Has built visibility across a portfolio of workstreams, using trackers, status reporting and tools such as Jira, and knows how to keep them honest without making them a burden
* A strong writer and storyteller, able to turn updates and numbers into something leaders grasp quickly

* Data-driven, comfortable building trackers and spotting when numbers don't add up
* Highly organised, able to manage many deadlines and very different kinds of work at once without losing detail

title: AI Adoption & Governance Manager
description:

Want to shape how an employee-owned engineering firm adopts AI? As Hazen’s AI Adoption & Governance Manager, you will lead the effort to make AI part of how every office and practice group works, with direct access to IT leadership and the authority to move quickly. If you are highly motivated, adaptable and energized by fast-moving technology, Hazen may be the place for you.

This position, which reports directly to the Director of Information Technology, leads the day-to-day support, adoption and governance of the firm’s AI tools: enterprise assistants like Copilot and Claude, AI features inside engineering and design software, and internal automations. Serves as the link between IT, project teams and leadership, so that staff use AI tools productively, safely and within firm policy.

This position will partner closely with senior members of the IT team and Design Technology, building on existing workflows and system requirements to shape how AI is supported across the firm. Candidates must work well in a team environment, be able to effectively prioritize and execute tasks, and be willing to learn and develop new skills that support the responsibilities outlined below. Because AI tools and the way Hazen uses them are changing quickly, the right person is nimble and responsive: able to reprioritize quickly, resolve issues as they arise, and adapt the support model as new tools and needs emerge.

Within the first year, AI is part of how nearly everyone at Hazen works. Staff in every office and practice group use approved AI tools confidently, productively and safely, and the support, training and governance model keeps pace as the tools evolve.

**Why Hazen and Sawyer:**

* Founded in 1951 by the son of Allen Hazen (developer of the Hazen-Williams equation), we are an employee-owned company with a singular focus on "all things water."
* Our work includes planning, design, and oversight of construction of environmental infrastructure – for water, wastewater, and stormwater management.
* We foster a work environment low on bureaucracy and high in creativity.
* We recruit talented professionals, provide them with challenging, interesting, and creative assignments, and furnish them with the tools they need to succeed.
* We currently have over 2,000 employees in 70+ offices throughout the United States, Latin America, Canada, and the UK.
* A flexible hybrid work schedule supports today's busy professionals.

**Key Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:**

* Own the support model for enterprise AI tools: intake, triage, escalation paths, knowledge base and service levels, in coordination with the Helpdesk Manager.
* Administer AI platforms: licensing, user provisioning, connectors and integrations, usage monitoring and cost tracking.
* Approve AI tools, pilots, integrations and configuration changes within firm policy, with the authority to act quickly and escalate to the Director of Information Technology only when risk, cost or a policy exception requires it.
* Run adoption and training: onboarding sessions, prompt libraries, office hours and a champions network across offices and practice groups.
* Partner with Design Technology on AI in engineering workflows (BIM/CAD, GIS, modeling, document production) and on evaluating new tools.
* Monitor new AI tools and features, including Copilot, Claude and AI in engineering software, assess their impact and opportunity, and adapt the support model and guidance as the technology evolves.

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.

* Strong training and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical limits to non-technical staff.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-changing environment: responsive, adaptable and comfortable reprioritizing quickly as needs shift.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AEC or engineering industry experience.
* ITIL certification.

* Build a proactive renewal operating model with clear milestones, ownership and escalation routes ahead of contract expiry.

* Establish visibility into upcoming renewals, customer risk, contraction and expansion opportunities.

* Set clear expectations for customer touchpoints, account plans, business reviews and risk escalation.
* Develop customer health scoring using product adoption, engagement, support and commercial indicators; measure effectiveness against customer outcomes.

* Establish a reliable view of customer and revenue performance, with clear metric definitions and ownership.
* Build dashboards that help leaders identify risks, prioritise activity and assess team effectiveness.
* Partner with systems owners to improve CRM data quality, workflow automation and reporting consistency.

* Set priorities and balance day-to-day operational requirements with longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Establish effective working practices across New York, London and Vancouver.

* Lead process changes through clear communication, practical training and measurement of adoption.

* Experience supporting financial services customers, regulated industries or complex enterprise contracts would be advantageous.

* Collaborate with partners across Sales, Planning, Ad Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Data to evaluate pricing, inventory, and product strategies that support near-term objectives and long-term growth.

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualifications and fluency in written and spoken English.
* Professional experience in advertising, media, or finance, ideally within a global organization.

* A proactive, collaborative mindset with strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Exposure to AI tools, machine learning, statistical modeling, scripting, or automation, with an interest in applying them to build scalable tools, improve analytical processes, and increase operational efficiency.
* Experience thinking strategically about product design, packaging, inventory allocation, and monetization, particularly across multiple platforms, markets, or audience segments.
* A track record of improving revenue efficiency, sell-through, inventory utilization, or pricing accuracy through analytical initiatives.
* Comfort developing and presenting data-backed recommendations, including challenging existing approaches when marketplace or performance data supports a different strategy.
* Interest in mentoring others and developing documentation, tools, or frameworks that make pricing, inventory, and Yield concepts more accessible across the organization.
